stories.title: Sensex falls over 100 pts, Nifty below 22,550 as market heads for 8th weekly loss, overtaking COVID crash. More pain ahead?

en.title: Sensex falls over 100 pts, Nifty below 22,550 as market heads for 8th weekly loss, overtaking COVID crash. More pain ahead?
en.summary: Indian stock benchmarks Sensex and Nifty declined for the fourth consecutive day, extending their losing streak to eight weeks. This marks the longest consecutive weekly decline since 2001, surpassing the seven-week downturn during the COVID pandemic, driven by foreign investor outflows and rising US bond yields.

stories.title: NSE gets Sebi nod to launch corporate bond index futures

en.title: NSE gets Sebi nod to launch corporate bond index futures
en.summary: India's National Stock Exchange received regulatory approval to introduce futures contracts based on a corporate bond index, pending Reserve Bank clearance. The move aims to provide better hedging tools as the corporate bond market expands.

en.summary: Fifty-five companies submitted initial public offering documents to India's market regulator in September before a deadline, with many facing complications if they miss the filing window. The IPO market has recovered momentum since July after earlier slowdowns.

stories.title: Can October turn the tide for Indian stocks after September rout?

en.title: Can October turn the tide for Indian stocks after September rout?
en.summary: Indian stocks face headwinds from elevated oil prices, rising bond yields, and foreign investor selling as October begins. Upcoming corporate earnings reports will be crucial in determining whether historically positive October returns materialize.
